item.title: The Gaslighting of Hannah Pettey
item.description: After a young woman nearly dies from poisoning, investigators focus on two people she trusted most. "48 Hours" correspondent Anne-Marie Green reports.

item.title: UN endorses new map that shows Africa's size more accurately
item.description: Africa has often been depicted smaller than its actual size on maps, which typically rely on an older projection.

item.title: Witkoff, Kushner meet with Putin to discuss Ukraine war
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin held a three-hour meeting with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on Saturday regarding the conflict in Ukraine.

item.title: Witkoff, Kushner arrive in Ukraine after Putin talks in push for peace
item.description: Following their meeting with Putin, Trump's envoys are set to discuss a proposal aimed at ending the war in Ukraine.
